resources.string: Dynamic colors follow your wallpaper on Android 12+.
How often live metrics refresh while a screen is visible. Longer intervals use less battery. Nothing is polled in the background.
Graphs are kept on this device only while you use the Monitor screen. Up to 2000 samples per metric.

Internet: only for the network diagnostics you start yourself (ping, DNS). Network state: to show whether you are on Wi-Fi or mobile data. Installed apps list: to find games and apps you may choose to stop; it never leaves your phone. Stop background processes: only for apps you confirm. FrameX reads no personal files.
